poems.title: Five Little Monkeys
lines: Five little monkeys jumping on the bed,
One fell off and bumped his head!
Mama called the doctor and the doctor said,
No more monkeys jumping on the bed!

poems.title: तितली उड़ी बस पर चढ़ी
lines: सीट ना मिली तो रोने लगी!
ड्राइवर ने बोला आजा मेरे पास,
तितली बोली ना बाबा ना, मेरा घर है पास!

courses.title: Solar System & Space Wonders
courses.subject: science
courses.description: Explore the Sun, Earth, Moon, Mars, and planets in outer space!

cards.subtitle: Center Star of our Solar System
cards.sentence: The Sun is a giant, glowing ball of fire that gives us light, warmth, and life every single day!
cards.spoken: The Sun is the giant star at the center of our solar system. It gives us light and life!

cards.subtitle: Our Beautiful Blue Home
cards.sentence: Earth is our wonderful home planet, full of blue oceans, green trees, animals, and fresh air!
cards.spoken: Planet Earth is our home! It is the only planet known to have life, water, and trees.

cards.subtitle: Earth's Night Companion
cards.sentence: The Moon orbits around Earth and lights up our night sky with its gentle silvery glow!
cards.spoken: The Moon is Earth's best friend in space, glowing softly in the night sky.

cards.subtitle: The Red Planet
cards.sentence: Mars is known as the Red Planet because of its iron-rich red dusty soil and giant volcanoes!
cards.spoken: Mars is the red planet! Scientists and rovers explore Mars to discover its secrets.

cards.subtitle: The Giant King of Planets
cards.sentence: Jupiter is the biggest planet in the solar system, so huge that all other planets could fit inside it!
cards.spoken: Jupiter is the giant king of planets, with huge swirling colorful storm clouds!

courses.title: Good Habits & Golden Manners
courses.subject: morals
courses.description: Essential daily habits, golden magic words, and health routines for smart champions!

cards.subtitle: Morning and Night Care
cards.sentence: Brush your teeth in the morning and before bed to keep germs away and smile brightly!
cards.spoken: Always brush your teeth twice every day for strong, shining, healthy white teeth!

cards.subtitle: Hygiene and Health
cards.sentence: Wash your hands with soap and water for 20 seconds before eating and after playing!
cards.spoken: Wash your hands clean with soap before eating any meal to stay strong and healthy.

cards.subtitle: Golden Courtesy
cards.sentence: Say 'Please' when asking for something, and 'Thank You' when someone helps you!
cards.spoken: Use magic words! Say Please when you ask, and Thank You with a warm smile!

cards.word: Early to Bed, Early to Rise ⏰
cards.subtitle: Healthy Sleep Routine
cards.sentence: Sleeping early and waking up with the sunrise makes you healthy, wealthy, and wise!
cards.spoken: Early to bed and early to rise makes a child healthy, happy, and super smart!
